name: Draught of the Red Hunger
summary: A red draught that thirsts back. The drinker makes a vampire's touch, as Vampiric Touch cast at 6th level with no Concentration, and for a minute can touch again as a Bonus Action.

powers.name: Drink
powers.text: Bonus Action: drink it and touch a creature within reach (Vampiric Touch at 6th level, no Concentration). For a minute you can touch again as a Bonus Action.
